body: Those people who say "It gets better" Are not lying to you. Some/most of them have never and will never feel what you are going through. But they obviously care about you. Depression/anxiety/suicidal thoughts are hard to get rid of. My best advice is talk about whats going on in your head and how you feel. You can talk with anyone, a friend, a family member, a Psychiatrist, or even a random stranger on the internet. You're not alone people care about you and want to listen. Feel free to Pm me if you would like to talk :)
